title: Melody A.M.
notes: Lush downtempo mosaics mix sampled melodies, delicate breakbeats, and gently pulsing house grooves.

title: The Understanding
notes: Sweeping synthetic landscapes and expressive guests connect melancholy slow builds with intense club rhythms.

title: Junior
notes: Vivid synth disco and pop surges meet distinctive guests and cinematic instrumental reprieves.

title: Senior
notes: Shadowy instrumental downtempo with warm synths, patient melodic arcs and restrained grooves.

title: The Inevitable End
notes: Pristine melancholic electronica pairs guest-led farewells with sparse introspection and occasional dance pulses.

title: Profound Mysteries
notes: An audiovisual return blending wistful synth instrumentals, guest vocals and surging club electronics.

title: Profound Mysteries II
notes: Retrofuturist synth-pop, vocal melancholy and rave excursions revisit formative electronic music.

title: Profound Mysteries III
notes: The trilogy turns inward, balancing glacial orchestration with widescreen rave and disco pieces.

title: Nebulous Nights (An Ambient Excursion into Profound Mysteries)
notes: Live-recorded analogue ambient reinterpretations soften trilogy themes into immersive, meditative listening.

title: True Electric
notes: Nineteen studio reconstructions turn earlier songs and tour arrangements into a sustained club set.
